parsed.name: CryoTel GT低温制冷机
parsed.description: Sunpower CryoTel GT是一款实验室用低温制冷机，用于为样品、传感器或小型冷端组件提供稳定低温环境。设备支持温度或功率控制，可读取当前温度、功率、状态与故障信息，并设置温度设定值、功率限制及恒温相关参数，适用于低温测试与低温实验平台。
parsed.description_en: The Sunpower CryoTel GT is a laboratory cryocooler used to provide a stable low-temperature environment for samples, sensors, or small cold-stage assemblies. It supports temperature or power control and allows users to read current temperature, power, status, and error information, as well as set temperature targets, power limits, and thermostat-related parameters for cryogenic testing and low-temperature experimental setups.
